levels.title: Small Tangle
levels.designNote: Five short winding routes make a compact first tangle with two clear opening choices.

levels.title: Compact Maze
levels.designNote: Six crossing-looking but legally separated routes fill a skewed maze with a short dependency chain.

levels.title: Heart in the Weave
levels.designNote: A dense heart-shaped footprint is drawn entirely by six winding arrows, including diagonal shoulders and a tapered point.

levels.title: Nested Paths
levels.designNote: Seven nested routes share a broad oval footprint; each arrow remains internally simple and self-clear.

levels.title: Dense Weave
levels.designNote: Seven routes pack an irregular shared footprint with repeated close neighbors and layered escape dependencies.

levels.title: Star Crossing
levels.designNote: Five winding paths collectively fill a stylized four-point star built from grid-aligned diagonals.

levels.title: Spiral Drift
levels.designNote: Eight interwoven paths occupy a broad C-shaped spiral footprint with a single deliberate opening.

levels.title: Broken Compass
levels.designNote: Eight routes fill an asymmetric, shifting footprint with several different safe removal orders.

levels.title: Evergreen
levels.designNote: Six winding arrows make a compact tiered canopy and trunk silhouette from the paths themselves.

levels.title: World Knot
levels.designNote: Nine long paths form the broadest weave, with multiple decision points and five dependency waves.
